stops.name: Cambridge Bus Terminal, Ainslie Street
stops.location_note: Official municipal ION station point for the Ainslie terminal area; the exact former GO platform is unverified.

stops.name: Cambridge Centre Bus Terminal
stops.location_note: Official municipal ION northbound curb point on Hespeler Road. GRT’s April2017 Cambridge Centre map explicitly shows GO24 using Hespeler curb stops outside the new terminal, not the former terminal south of the mall; used as a station-area reference.
